summary: How to add a procedurally generated FK Control Rig track to any Skeletal Mesh in Sequencer (no Control Rig asset needed), keyframe bones, use it additively over an animation, bake an Animation Sequence to it for fixes, bake back, and filter the bone list.
keys: Select Bones Or Curves To Animate
gotchas: Works only inside Sequencer on a Skeletal Mesh track
Key with S in viewport or Enter in Sequencer
Warm Up Frames / Delay Before Start help when post-process Anim Blueprint effects need time to settle before baking

summary: Quick start for Control Rig: create a Control Rig asset from a Skeletal Mesh, add an FK control in the Rig Hierarchy, set its shape, drive a bone with Get Control/Set Bone off Forwards Solve, and keyframe it in Sequencer.
gotchas: Best practice is to unparent controls from the skeleton (Shift+P) and build a separate control hierarchy
Clicking Compile resets control positions to default

summary: Python snippet reference for Control Rig animation in Sequencer: creating FK/regular/layered Control Rig tracks, getting/setting control values per frame, key selection, curve editor, loading anim sequences into rig sections, tween/snapper/space switching, constraints, baking to/from AnimSequence, and FBX import/export.
gotchas: Control Rig tracks need a Control Rig class (FKControlRig.static_class() or rig.get_control_rig_class())
Layered Control Rigs evaluate highest priority number first
Snapper: an animated driver object must be added to the active sequence
load_anim_sequence_into_control_rig_section uses the backwards solve graph

summary: Explains Control Rig Space Switching: dynamically re-parenting controls to Parent, World, or other rig elements in Sequencer via the Animation Mode Spaces panel, keyframing and baking spaces, pre-defining Available Spaces in the rig asset, and Dynamic Hierarchy graph nodes.
gotchas: Requires Animation Mode enabled; press Tab in viewport for temporary Spaces menu
Prefer Controls as custom spaces to avoid cyclical rig errors
Set Parent Weights count must equal the element's number of parents

summary: Hub page for rigging with Control Rig: two ways to create a Control Rig asset (from a Skeletal Mesh, or Animation > Control Rig then Import Hierarchy) and links to rigging feature pages.
gotchas: A manually created Control Rig needs the Skeletal Mesh assigned via Import Hierarchy

summary: Overview of the IK Rig editor: creating an IK Rig asset, its panels (Hierarchy, Solver Stack, IK Retargeting chains), IK Goal properties, viewport settings, and a worked foot-IK example with Set Transform and Limb IK solvers, goals and root bones.
keys: Set Root Bone on Selected Solver
gotchas: Solvers execute in stack order; order matters
Limb IK needs both a goal and a root bone
Swapping Preview Skeletal Mesh fails if bone names/hierarchy are incompatible
Preview Mode Additive/Absolute is editor-only; runtime additive needs Manual Input + Additive on the IK Rig anim node

summary: Step-by-step guide to playing a video on a Static Mesh with a File Media Source, Media Player and Media Texture, adding a Media Sound component, and opening the source from the Level Blueprint on Begin Play.
gotchas: Video files must be in Content/Movies to be packaged automatically
Media outside Content/Movies plays in editor but is not deployed
Media Plate Actor (since 5.1) is an alternative to this manual workflow

summary: Hub page pointing to animation debugging and optimization tools: Rewind Debugger, Animation Insights, Pose Watch, Animation Optimization, and the Animation Budget Allocator plugin.

Reference for AnimGraph blend nodes (Apply Additive, Blend, Blend Bone by Channel, Blend Multi, Blend Poses by bool/int/Enum, Layered blend per bone with Branch Filter/Blend Mask) and inertial blending with Inertialization and Dead Blending nodes, including how blend nodes, state machine transitions and anim layers request it.
gotchas: Dead Blending node is experimental; not recommended for shipping
Inertialization request without an Inertialization/Dead Blending node downstream logs a runtime error
Anim Notifies from the source anim stop firing once inertial blending begins
Anim Layers can only blend in/out via inertial blending

summary: Explains Sequencer's Object Binding Track: adding actors to a sequence, changing/removing/multi-binding actors (also from Blueprint), adding component tracks to reach all properties, and configuring automatic default tracks per actor class in Level Sequencer project settings.
gotchas: Rebinding to a different class leaves class-specific tracks that stop working without a compatible component
With multi-bound actors of different classes only the first actor's components are accessible

summary: Tutorial converting the Third Person Blueprint template into a top-down 2D game: import a Paper 2D sprite sheet, create Flipbooks, build a PaperCharacter Blueprint with an overhead Spring Arm camera, copy movement input, and set it as Default Pawn Class.
Short example of enabling Simulate Physics on a Paper 2D sprite and using Constraints (Lock Position, Lock Rotation, or Mode XZPlane) to keep it in the 2D plane in a side scroller.
gotchas: Without constraints, physics sprites tumble out of the 2D plane and can fall off the world

summary: How to add sockets to Paper 2D sprites (bulk-add via Property Matrix across flipbook frames) and attach a spawned actor to a sprite socket in Blueprint with Spawn Actor from Class and Attach To.
gotchas: Every sprite frame in a Flipbook needs its own socket with the same name, adjusted per frame

summary: Explains Distance Matching: generating a distance curve with the Distance Curve Modifier, required Uniform Indexable curve compression, and driving a Sequence Evaluator via an Anim Node Function with Distance Match to Target; also covers Advance Time By Distance Matching and Set Playrate to Match Speed.
gotchas: Requires the Animation Locomotion Library plugin
Curve generation needs a Root Motion enabled sequence
Sequence must use Uniform Indexable curve compression to read the curve at runtime

summary: Reference and workflow for Pose Warping AnimGraph nodes (Orientation, Stride, Slope Warping) with Manual vs Graph modes, property tables, an Orientation Warping setup with Local To Component and Leg IK, and debug draw options.
gotchas: Requires the Animation Warping plugin and Root Motion enabled animations
Slope Warping is still in development; don't rely on it in a project
Orientation Warping needs a downstream Leg IK node and spine/IK foot bones defined or it fails to compile

summary: Guide to Epic's Game Animation Sample Project (Motion Matching locomotion/traversal): installing from Fab, controls and the Game Animation Widget debug panel, retargeting your own character via ABP_GenericRetarget and a CBP_Sandbox_Character child, migrating animations, and a breakdown of ABP_SandboxCharacter's AnimGraph nodes and functions.
gotchas: Offset Root Bone node is experimental; translation offset has no collision checks and can clip into geometry
Character Override replaces the Game Mode Pawn Class
Turn in place while aiming is still WIP
Your character needs an IK Rig and an IK Retargeter from UEFN_Mannequin plus a matching Component Tag

summary: How to debug Motion Matching with the Pose Search plugin's Rewind Debugger integration: recording gameplay, the Pose Search track, and reading the selection table (Active Pose, Continuing Pose, Pose Candidates, cost/bias/flags, Channels Breakdown).
gotchas: Requires Animation Insights and Pose Search plugins enabled and editor restart
Gray values in the table are poses that are ignored entirely

summary: Explains importing 2D content for Paper 2D: Texture Packer .paper2dsprites export (sprite sheet, frames, auto Flipbooks) and Tiled / Adobe Flash CS6 .json import that builds Tile Sets and a Tile Map.
gotchas: Set Border and Shape Padding to 0 in Texture Packer for clean tiling/flipbooks
Don't separately import the .png; it is included with .paper2dsprites

summary: Hub page: introduces the Paper 2D how-to series of short step-by-step guides; links only.

Describes Paper 2D Flipbooks (sprite keyframes with durations and Frames Per Second) and how to create them blank via Add > Animation > Paper Flipbook or auto-generated from selected sprites with Create Flipbook.
gotchas: Auto-generated Flipbooks order sprites alphabetically, so name frames like Idle_1, Idle_2

summary: Covers the Face AR Sample: driving character blend shapes and joints from Apple ARKit face tracking via Live Link, ARSessionConfig setup, AppleARKitFaceMesh component, Pose Assets, curve remapping, calibration, and deploying to iPhone.
gotchas: Only on iOS devices with a front-facing TrueDepth camera
Wants Collision on the face mesh is very expensive
Device and computer must be on the same network for Live Link

summary: How to fire Blueprint logic from a Level Sequence with the Event Track: Trigger vs Repeater events, binding keys to Event Endpoints in the sequence's Director Blueprint, parameters/payloads, object-bound events with Pass Bound Object To and Quick Bind, and track properties like Fire Event when Forwards/Backwards and Event Position.
gotchas: Events do nothing until bound to an Event Endpoint
Repeater evaluation rate follows the sequence Frames Per Second
Call In Editor makes the event run in the editor without PIE

summary: Reference for every Sequencer toolbar button and menu: World binding (Auto Bind to PIE/Simulate), Create Camera, Render/MRQ, Director Blueprint, Actions (FBX import/export, Bake Transform, Fix Actor References, Volatile), View, Playback, Keyframe/tangent, Auto Key, Edit, Snapping, and Frames Per Second/Clock Source options.
keys: Lock to Display Rate at Runtime
gotchas: Auto Key only adds keys if the track already has at least one key
Volatile must be set if sequence data is changed procedurally at runtime
Rerun Construction Scripts also needs Run Construction Script in Sequencer in the Blueprint's Class Settings
Bake Transform disables existing attachment/transform tracks by default

summary: Shows three ways to animate materials in Sequencer: swap materials with a Material Element Switcher track, keyframe parameters with a Material Parameter Element track on a mesh component, and drive many materials via a Material Parameter Collection Track.
gotchas: Add the Mesh Component track first; element numbers match the mesh's Material Elements
Overlapping Material Parameter sections blend between states

summary: How to add Sound Waves/Sound Cues to a Level Sequence with the Audio Track: trimming, looping, fades and crossfades, attaching sounds to actors or bones with attenuation for spatial audio, and the Pitch/Volume tracks and section properties.
gotchas: Trimmed audio sections may not play correctly unless Sound Asset Compression Type is Bink Audio or PCM
Can only attach to Actors referenced in the Level Sequence
A dedicated Audio Track under an Actor cannot be re-attached elsewhere

summary: How to fade the screen to a color with Sequencer's Fade Track (0-1 float), set Fade Color/Fade Audio/When Finished, and combine it with Start Camera Fade on the Player Camera Manager for gameplay-to-cinematic and cinematic-to-gameplay transitions.
gotchas: Set When Finished to Keep State or the fade reverts when the sequence ends
Start Camera Fade with Duration 0 does not work
Start Camera Fade's exec output fires immediately; add a Delay to wait for completion
Different fade colors need separate sections

summary: How to apply console variables over a time range in a Level Sequence with the Console Variable Track, entering comma-separated cvars in a section's Properties > Console Variables.
gotchas: Previous cvar values are restored when the section ends
For offline renders, Movie Render Queue console variable settings are suggested instead

summary: Walkthrough toggling whole sublevels Visible/Hidden during a sequence with the Level Visibility Track, using Always Loaded sublevels and the Level Names property on Visibility Trigger sections.
gotchas: Does not stream levels in/out; content stays in memory and is only shown or hidden
Sublevels must be added to the persistent level (Always Loaded in the example)

summary: How to play an image sequence or movie from Sequencer with the Media Track using an Img Media Source and Media Texture (internal Media Player is created automatically), plus IMG Media cache and pre-roll tuning.
gotchas: MP4 and other movie formats in the Media Track are experimental, as is rendering Media Tracks
Media section does not auto-size to media length
Each section must have its Media Texture set; no two sections may write the same Media Texture at once
Set Cache Behind Percentage to 0 for real-time playback

summary: How to speed up or slow down a cinematic with the Time Dilation Track, including keyframing it for a time-warp effect; it changes the global time scale of the whole level.
gotchas: Affects global time of all simulations in the level (particles, materials, etc.), not just sequence tracks

summary: How to create and use Folder tracks to organize Sequencer's Outliner: Add Folder, Move to Folder, Ctrl+G, subfolders, renaming, removal and folder colors.

How to change a sequence's playback speed with the Time Warp track using a fixed Play Rate Curve or a keyframed Time Warp Curve (frame-to-frame mapping), with dual playheads during playback; affects only the sequence, not the game.
gotchas: Only affects objects in the level sequence; use Time Dilation track for whole-game timing
Time Warp Curve auto-adds keys at start/end bounds; Play Rate Curve does not

summary: How to statically or dynamically override IK Retargeter Global, Root and Chain settings at runtime via the Custom Retarget Profile on the Retarget Pose From Mesh node, with an FBIK arm example and animating an exposed chain setting from Sequencer.
keys: Get Chain Settings from Retarget Profile
Set Chain IKSettings in Retarget Profile
gotchas: Requires runtime retargeting already set up with Retarget Pose From Mesh
IK chain settings need IK goals/solver in the target IK Rig
FBIK Root Behavior should be Pin to Input so the lower body doesn't move

summary: Hub page: index of pages on Unreal Engine animation assets and features; contains no other content.
